title: Transcriptome analysis of the effects of melanocortin analogues, as well as Selank and PGP in differentiated SH-SY5Y cells at 2 days of senescence
description:
Summary. Cellular senescence contributes to pathophysiology of stroke and neurodegenerative disorders. Counteracting cellular senescence may be essential for the therapy of multiple disorders. Here, we study the effects of the peptides MEHFPGP (ACTH(4-7)PGP, Semax), HFRWPGP (ACTH(6-9)PGP), and TKPRPGP (Selank) on the transcriptome in differentiated SH-SY5Y cells at 2 days of senescence. To explore the mechanisms that might account the protective effect of the peptides we investigated changes in the expression of cellular mRNA in the cell senescence model induced by D-galactose and under peptides treatment.

Overall design. Cells SH-SY5Y were differentiated with retinoic acid through 7 days and exposed to D-galactose at a final concentration of 150 mM for 2 days. Peptides at a final concentration of 1 mM were added simultaneously with D-galactose. Control samples were exposed to medium without D-galactose, equal volume of peptide diluent (phosphate-buffered saline) was added to untreated samples. All experiments were performed in triplicates.

Growth and treatment protocol. SH-SY5Y cells were cultured under standard conditions in DMEM/F12 medium (Paneco, Russia) containing 10% fetal bovine serum, 2 mM alanyl glutamine, 40 mcg per ml gentamicin in a CO2 incubator at 37C and 5 percent CO2 to 70-80% confluence. For differentiation 750 thousands cells were seeded into T25 culture flasks in growth medium. Next day growth medium was removed, cells were rinsed with DPBS buffer and fresh DMEM F12 medium containing 1 percent FBS and 10 mcM all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) was added and cells were further cultivated for 7 days. The medium was renewed on the fifth day. On the eighth day the medium was changed to fresh medium containing 150 mM D-galactose and 1 mM peptide or DPBS and cells cultivated for 2 days, medium renewed daily.

Transcriptome analysis. Total RNA was extracted using TRI-reagent (MRC Inc., USA). Genome-wide transcriptome analysis of mRNA level in SH-SY5Y cells was carried out using high-throughput RNA-sequencing (RNA-Seq). Sequencing was carried out using an Illumina NextSeq2000 instrument. At least 10 million reads (1/50 nt) were generated.
